files.name: motion-prompt-010.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Overshoot" (オーバーシュート), one of the names in "Motion graphics moves".
Motion Prompt #010

What it is: Goes a little past the target, then settles back
What the sample shows: A gauge needle swings past its target, comes back and settles.
Spec:
- One pass per 4.7 s. Semicircular gauge (radius 128, stroke 26). Target is 0.7 of the sweep (126° from the left end).
- Starts at 0.25 s: value = 0.7 × (1 − e^(−4.6t)·cos(10.5t)). About 0.3 s later it is roughly 25% past the target, then it oscillates and settles on the target.
- The part beyond the target is drawn in coral. A yellow tick marks the target.
- The filled arc is a blue→mint gradient; the needle is white, width 9.
- Return: from 3.7 s, value = 0.7 × e^(−7.5t)·cos(8.5t) back to 0 (dipping slightly below 0 before it stops).
When to use it: Use it to give an arriving element energy and a springy feel.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/010.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/motion.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
